pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:1.2: tena kho pana samayena thullanandā bhikkhunī rathiyāyapi byūhepi siṅghāṭakepi purisena saddhiṃ ekenekā santiṭṭhatipi sallapatipi nikaṇṇikampi jappeti dutiyikampi bhikkhuniṃ uyyojeti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:1.3: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:1.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā rathiyāyapi byūhepi siṅghāṭakepi purisena saddhiṃ ekenekā santiṭṭhissatipi sallapissatipi nikaṇṇikampi jappasseti dutiyikampi bhikkhuniṃ uyyojessatī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:1.5: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī rathiyāyapi byūhepi siṅghāṭakepi purisena saddhiṃ ekenekā santiṭṭhatipi sallapatipi nikaṇṇikampi jappeti dutiyikampi bhikkhuniṃ uyyojetīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī rathiyāyapi byūhepi siṅghāṭakepi purisena saddhiṃ ekenekā santiṭṭhissatipi sallapissatipi nikaṇṇikampi jappessati. dutiyikampi bhikkhuniṃ uyyojessati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:1.10: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:1.11.1: “yā pana bhikkhunī rathiyāya vā byūhe vā siṅghāṭake vā purisena saddhiṃ ekenekā santiṭṭheyya vā sallapeyya vā nikaṇṇikaṃ vā jappeyya dutiyikaṃ vā bhikkhuniṃ uyyojeyya pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:2.1.12: manussapuriso na yakkho na peto na tiracchānagato viññū paṭibalo santiṭṭhituṃ sallapituṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:2.1.20: purisassa hatthapāse ṭhitā sallapati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:2.1.24: anācāraṃ ācaritukāmā dutiyikampi bhikkhuniṃ uyyojeti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:2.1.25: dassanūpacāraṃ vā savaṇūpacāraṃ vā vijahantiyā āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:2.2.1: hatthapāsaṃ vijahitvā santiṭṭhati vā sallapati vā āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:2.2.2: yakkhena vā petena vā paṇḍakena vā tiracchānagatamanussaviggahena vā saddhiṃ santiṭṭhati vā sallapati vā āpatti dukkaṭassa.
